scope: Proposition 9.5 (Uniform positive lower bound) of the manuscript “Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape” (preprints/Strict-convexity-and-differentiability-of-the-planar-exponential-first-passage-limit-shape-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is c0 > 0, depending only on the fixed flat and the dependence radius 10, such that b(n) ≥ c0 (9.9) for all sufficiently large admissible n. The constant c0 is independent of the road rules, of sufficiently small s, and of the nearby rational directions. The lower threshold on n may depend on s and the divisibility requirements.
